generation.ifuzz: syzkaller arm64 user-mode table, no filters, defaults (1..24 insns)
generation.fixer: --ref-cores 0,32,64,96 --repeat 3, default 4 data pages, no targeting flags

region_definition.formula: R(x) = union(F(w) for w in words(x)) - F(nop)
region_definition.F: SanitizerCoverage counters inside instrumented libcapstone for decoding w
region_definition.rationale: Capstone proxy decodes one instruction per input, so a template's region is the union over its instructions; same rule for streams
